description: Two workers on a flat rooftop at dusk installing a solar water heater - evacuated tube collector array plus tank, with city lights visible in the background. Striking dusk-lit installation shot.
Paving bricks lifted next to a house wall to expose a poly pipe joint, muddy water pooled in the hole, worker's hands and tools (tape measure, hammer, pliers, bucket) around the excavation.
Worker in blue overalls bent over checking a new wall-mounted basin and chrome tap installed on a wooden vanity cabinet, in a modern grey-tiled bathroom. Clean finished-bathroom install shot.
Close-up of a geyser heating element pulled out and held in hand, visible scale/mineral buildup on the coil, a multimeter/clamp meter and tools in the background. Diagnostic/element-replacement shot.
